title: TCS & Infosys Placement Grand Arena (15 Questions)
description: Comprehensive 15-question placement assessment covering Quantitative, Logical, Verbal, and Data Interpretation.

questions.text: A pipe can fill a cistern in 12 hours, while another pipe can empty it in 18 hours. If both pipes are opened simultaneously, in how many hours will the cistern be completely filled?
questions.explanation: Net filling rate per hour = 1/12 - 1/18 = (3 - 2)/36 = 1/36. Hence, it takes 36 hours to fill completely.

questions.text: A train 240 m long passes a pole in 24 seconds. How long will it take to pass a platform 650 m long?
questions.explanation: Speed = 240 m / 24 s = 10 m/s. Total distance to cross platform = 240 + 650 = 890 m. Time = 890 / 10 = 89 seconds.

questions.text: If the compound interest on a sum for 2 years at 10% per annum is ₹1,050, what would be the simple interest on the same sum at the same rate and for the same time?
questions.explanation: CI formula for 2 years at 10%: Effective CI rate = 10 + 10 + (10*10)/100 = 21%. Given 21% of P = 1050 => P = ₹5,000. SI for 2 years at 10% = 20% of 5,000 = ₹1,000.

questions.text: In how many different ways can the letters of the word "PLACEMENT" be arranged so that the vowels always come together?
questions.explanation: PLACEMENT has 9 letters: P, L, A, C, E, M, E, N, T. Vowels are A, E, E (3 vowels, with E repeating twice). Consonants are P, L, C, M, N, T (6 consonants). Treat vowels as 1 block: (6 + 1) = 7 units. Ways to arrange = 7! = 5040. Inside vowel block (A, E, E): 3! / 2! = 3 ways. Total ways = 5040 * 3 = 15,120.

questions.text: Pointing to a gentleman, Deepak said, "His only brother is the father of my daughter's father." How is the gentleman related to Deepak?
questions.explanation: Deepak's daughter's father is Deepak himself. The father of Deepak is his father. The gentleman's only brother is Deepak's father. Therefore, the gentleman is Deepak's uncle.

questions.text:
Statements: All laptops are machines. Some machines are smart devices. No smart device is analog.
Conclusions:
I. Some laptops are smart devices.
II. No machine is analog.
questions.explanation: Laptops are machines, and some machines are smart devices, but there is no necessary overlap between laptops and smart devices. Also, machines that are not smart devices could be analog. Thus neither conclusion follows necessarily.

questions.text: Find the missing number in the series: 7, 13, 27, 53, 107, ?

Six executives P, Q, R, S, T, and U sit around a circular conference table facing the center. P sits second to the left of U. Q sits opposite to S. R is not an immediate neighbor of P. If T sits to the immediate right of U, who sits opposite to P?
questions.explanation: Fix U at position 1 (facing center). Immediate right of U is pos 6: T. Second left of U is pos 3: P. Positions 2, 4, 5 remain. Q sits opposite S: across 6 positions, opposite means difference of 3. Positions 1 & 4, 2 & 5, 3 & 6 are opposite pairs. Pos 1 has U, Pos 6 has T, Pos 3 has P. So Q and S must occupy 2 & 5! Thus pos 4 must be R. Opposite of P (pos 3) is pos 4 (which is R).

questions.text: Select the word that is most nearly OPPOSITE in meaning to the capitalized word: "The manager was criticized for his BELLICOSE attitude during client disputes."
questions.explanation: "Bellicose" means demonstrating aggression and willingness to fight. Its antonym is "Conciliatory" (peace-seeking, placating).

questions.text: Identify the sentence with the correct grammatical structure and subject-verb agreement:
options: Neither the project manager nor the software developers was aware of the database breach.
Neither the project manager nor the software developers were aware of the database breach.
Either the system analysts or the architect have made an error in the schema.
A collection of technical articles were published in the quarterly tech journal.
questions.explanation: In "neither... nor...", the verb agrees with the nearer subject. Since "software developers" is plural, the plural verb "were" is correct.

questions.text:
Rearrange the sentences into a coherent paragraph:
P: Consequently, recruiters look for problem-solving adaptability.
Q: Algorithmic hiring tests have evolved drastically over the last decade.
R: Instead of rote memorization, real-world case simulations are now evaluated.
S: Modern enterprise tech stacks change faster than university curriculums.
questions.explanation: Q introduces the evolution of algorithmic hiring tests. S provides the underlying driver (fast tech stack evolution). R specifies the shift from memorization to case simulations. P wraps up with the concluding takeaway ("Consequently...").

questions.text: Refer to the table below showing Placement Offers across 4 Engineering Branches over 3 Years. What is the ratio of total offers in CS & IT to total offers in ECE & Mech in Year 2024?
Based on the company hiring expenditure table below, by what approximate percentage did the Recruitment Tech cost increase from 2023 to 2024?
questions.explanation: Recruitment Tech in 2023 = 36 Lakhs. In 2024 = 48 Lakhs. Increase = 48 - 36 = 12 Lakhs. Percentage increase = (12 / 36) * 100 = 33.33%.

questions.text: Examine the candidate qualification funnel table. If the target was to achieve at least a 15% overall conversion from Aptitude Test to Final Offer, by how many candidates did the company fall short?
questions.explanation: Aptitude Test appeared = 1200. Target 15% = 0.15 * 1200 = 180 candidates. Actual final offers = 162. Shortfall = 180 - 162 = 18 candidates.
